text:
ashok: Heads-up: found a temporary exemption applied to AcmeCorp (org_8921) that has no expiry and no audit event. Created because of 'sales demo' yesterday. This will bypass per-key burst controls.

maria: Can you paste the exact support command/log? I'll loop in support-sre if needed.

ashok: Here's the DB change I found in the logs:
```sql
UPDATE rate_allowlist SET expires_at = NULL, reason = 'sales_demo' WHERE org_id='org_8921';
```
It looks like the support UI allowed blank TTL.

jordan: Yikes. We also saw bursts from that org hitting dedicated pool last night. Would have auto-failed if not for fallback. No rollback event in audit-service.

support-bot: automated: incident-ticket #INC-4487 created: 'Transient demo exemption for org_8921' by support_user.

ivan: Long term: require expires_at non-null and store created_by + activity_id. Short-term patch: reject NULL TTL in API, and add a scheduled job to expire any open exemptions older than 24h. Also add console default TTL=4h.

maria: @ivan can you draft the migration? I can take console UX. For the patch, adding DB constraint:
```sql
ALTER TABLE rate_allowlist ADD CONSTRAINT expires_not_null CHECK (expires_at IS NOT NULL);
```
but we need backfill for existing rows.

jordan: Backfill plan: set expires_at = created_at + interval '4 hours' for rows with NULL and insert audit events. I'll own a script. Also add metric 'temp_allowlist_count' + trace id on support actions.

ashok: Action items: ivan -> PR for API/DB constraint + scheduled expiry (EOD), jordan -> backfill script and metrics (tomorrow morning), maria -> console UX + default TTL and confirm support docs updated. I'll follow up with a quick runbook for support not to create open exemptions. Thanks.

maria: :thumbsup: adding to eng-platform board. Should we also require reason tag enforced? (sales/poc/demo) so we can filter.

ivan: Yes enforce enum for reason. I'll include in PR.

support-bot: automated: note added to ticket INC-4487: 'expiry enforced plan in progress'.
